$comment: Compute Backend Inventory — configurable sources of compute for generation. Managed via the Admin panel → Compute tab (CRUD over this file) and read at backend startup. Each backend declares which model_family capabilities it can run; the registry/router resolve the enabled backend per request. `type` is 'comfyui' (any headless/desktop ComfyUI server reachable by base_url) or 'runpod' (serverless container with an ephemeral ComfyUI — submit via the RunPod client). Secrets (RunPod endpoint IDs, API keys) stay in .env; this file only references them by name.

backends.name: ai-kvm2 ComfyUI (local)
backends.notes: Default local server on ai-kvm2. systemd comfyui, always_on.

backends.name: Windows-PC ComfyUI
backends.notes: User's Windows PC (ComfyUI portable) running local MiniMax-H3.

backends.name: RunPod serverless cloud
backends.notes: Serverless containers, each an ephemeral ComfyUI. Endpoint IDs in .env.
